image_prompts.visual_anchor_used: A guard in heavy armor standing at a concrete perimeter gate, holding a large leather checklist, symbolizing ACL checks at the perimeter
image_prompts.flux_scene_description: Low-angle wide shot of a guard in heavy armor standing at a concrete perimeter gate, holding a large leather checklist, while a small figure with a keycard wanders inside the gate area. The background shows a distant runway and a clear sky.

image_prompts.visual_anchor_used: A blindfolded guard at a stone castle gate turning his back on approaching figures, representing Zero Trust's 'trust no one' principle
image_prompts.flux_scene_description: Mid-shot of a guard wearing a blindfold, standing at a stone castle gate, turning his back on a line of approaching figures. The gate is heavy and locked, with no open doors. The background shows a moody, overcast sky.

image_prompts.visual_anchor_used: A hand placing a translucent veil over a stack of bound log books, illustrating privacy and differential privacy
image_prompts.flux_scene_description: High-angle shot of a hand gently draping a translucent, semi-transparent veil over a stack of bound log books on a wooden desk. The veil shimmers with faint, diffused light, obscuring the details of the logs. The background is a dim office with a single window.

image_prompts.visual_anchor_used: A closed leather ledger book with a fountain pen resting on an open page, ink drying, symbolizing permanent, unchangeable entries
image_prompts.flux_scene_description: Extreme macro of a closed leather ledger book with a thick cover, a fountain pen resting on an open page, ink still drying, surrounded by a faint glow. The background is a dark, blurred study desk.

image_prompts.visual_anchor_used: A person standing before a podium with three colored flags representing student, TA, instructor roles
image_prompts.flux_scene_description: Over-the-shoulder shot of a person standing before a podium holding a clipboard, with three colored flags (blue, green, red) hanging on a pole beside the podium. The flags are slightly raised, each distinct color. The background is a simple classroom wall.

image_prompts.visual_anchor_used: Two figures separated by a wall with a crack, each holding a glowing microchip, symbolizing a covert channel
image_prompts.flux_scene_description: Side view of two figures in contrasting colors standing on either side of a solid wall with a narrow crack. Each figure holds a small glowing microchip, and a faint light passes through the crack connecting them. The background is a dim, industrial corridor.
